children: Agarwal will take charge as CFO from 17 September, succeeding Interim CFO Ambarish Raghuvanshi

Info Edge (India) has appointed Himanshu Agarwal as its Chief Financial Officer and Additional Director, effective 17 September 2026. His appointment as Whole-time Director for a five-year term, from 17 September 2026 to 16 September 2031, is subject to shareholder and other applicable statutory approvals.

Agarwal will take over as CFO from Ambarish Raghuvanshi, who has been serving as the company’s Interim CFO since 20 November 2025. Raghuvanshi’s tenure as Interim CFO will conclude at the close of business hours on 16 September 2026.
Raghuvanshi will continue to be associated with Info Edge as Finance Advisor until 31 October 2026 and will provide advisory support during the transition and handover period.

Agarwal has more than three decades of experience in finance leadership, corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions, and business transformation across listed organisations in India and internationally.
As CFO and Whole-time Director, Agarwal will take responsibility for the company’s finance function, subject to the applicable approvals.

Separately, Info Edge has appointed Naresh Chand Gupta as an Additional Director in the Independent category, effective 1 October 2026. Gupta is proposed to serve as a Non-Executive Independent Director for five years, from 1 October 2026 to 30 September 2031, subject to shareholder approval and other applicable statutory approvals.

Gupta is a designated partner at Accuracap Technologies LLP and Chief Scientist at Accuracap Consultancy Services. He also serves as an Independent Director on the boards of eClerx Services and NoPaperForms Solutions. He previously served as Managing Director of Adobe Systems India and as an Independent Director at Affle (India), now known as Affle 3i. He was also an Independent Director on Info Edge’s board until 31 March 2023.

Info Edge Chairman Kapil Kapoor said Agarwal’s appointment as Whole-time Director and CFO would strengthen the company’s finance and leadership capabilities. He also acknowledged Raghuvanshi’s contribution during his tenure as Interim CFO.

Managing Director, Chief Executive Officer and Co-Promoter Hitesh Oberoi said Agarwal’s experience in finance leadership, mergers and acquisitions and governance would support the company’s finance function.
The leadership changes will take effect in September and October 2026, with Raghuvanshi continuing in an advisory capacity through the transition period.
